name: humanbody-anatomy
description: An interactive, turning 3D human anatomy model: click any part of the body to learn what it is and how it works.

scripts.fetch-data: sh tools/fetch-bodyparts3d.sh data/bodyparts3d && sh tools/fetch-hra.sh data/hra
scripts.model: node tools/classify.mjs data/bodyparts3d tools/manifest.json && node tools/build-model.mjs data/bodyparts3d && node --max-old-space-size=8000 tools/build-model.mjs data/bodyparts3d --female data/hra
